dbo.archive_monthly_reports.summary: Preserves completed monthly reports in dbo.report_archive, supporting the reporting workflow after each report is generated.

dbo.build_monthly_report.summary: Builds the monthly billing report from payment and reconciliation results. This brings those processing outputs together for downstream reporting and archiving.

dbo.clean_invoice_records.summary: Prepares invoice and payment records for reliable reconciliation, then starts the reconciliation procedure so downstream reporting uses the updated results.
steps: Read from dbo.clean_invoices, dbo.payment_imports, and dbo.payments.

dbo.dynamic_rate_refresh.summary: Refreshes rates using dbo.rate_sources. Because the procedure uses dynamic SQL, its exact runtime dependencies remain uncertain to the parser.

dbo.load_invoices.summary: Starts the invoice-processing flow by moving staged invoices into clean tables, recording audit or error details, and invoking the cleanup procedure.
steps: Write to dbo.audit_log, dbo.clean_invoices, and dbo.error_log.

dbo.nightly_cleanup.summary: Applies dbo.cleanup_policy during scheduled cleanup, expires sessions, and records the work in the audit log to support operational maintenance.

dbo.reconcile_payments.summary: Matches cleaned invoices with payment matches and records the reconciliation results. This supplies the payment and reconciliation data used by monthly reporting.
